[[File:Rat icon.png|left]]
'''Rats''' are small animals which can be found in numerous locations, mostly in cities, sewers and dungeons. They are best found outside and on the {{FloorNumber|1}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]]. Their tails are most commonly used for the completion of the [[Witch's Potion (miniquest)|Witch's Potion]] [[miniquests|miniquest]], and they are one of the weakest creatures in ''RuneScape''. The only rats that drop bones are those in the [[Stronghold of Security]]. They are good for training on for new players as they have low life points and defence and [[respawn]] in only a few seconds, but they can be hard to click as they're small and move very fast.
[[File:Rat idle animation.gif|frame|left|A rat in its idle animation.]]
{{clear|left}}
==Cats==
Players who have a [[cat]] or a kitten can tell it to chase vermin, in which case it will try to attack any rat in range. If your cat catches at least 100 rats you can go to [[Gertrude]] to get a [[cat training medal]] (no special bonuses). Also, if you have a [[rat pole]], a rat will be added to it each time a rat is caught by your cat.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Havenhythe Out Now|date=23 March 2026}}
** Added to [[Hollow Hill]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (17 June 2013)|date=17 June 2013}}
** Rats behind Lumbridge Castle now drop items as intended.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 November 2010)|date=9 November 2010}}
** Rats’ animations have been tweaked to not have their wounds open up massively.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (17 November 2009)|date=17 November 2009}}
** Corrected several animations for rats and mice, especially in Rat Catchers.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
[[File:Ratwheel.png|thumb|172px|The class pet from the now-discontinued [[Surprise Exam]] random event]]
* The examine text is based on the {{WP|Discworld|Discworld books}} by Terry Pratchett, who goes into detail describing the ways dwarves eat rats.
* There is a [[HiScores]] for rat kills, but only people who completed [[Samuel LeBaux|Sameul LeBaux's]] [[2015 April Fools#Trouble and Squeak|300 task miniquest]] (3,000 rat kills) are able to get ranked. 5,000 is the minimum to be ranked.
